subject: Real Estate Transfer Fee Proposal
overview: Councilor Matt Leming delivered a video update discussing the public reaction to a proposed real estate transfer fee, tenant displacement in Medford, and efforts to fund the Affordable Housing Trust.

items.title: Real Estate Transfer Fee Proposal
items.summary: Councilor Matt Leming recapped his resolution to explore a real estate transfer fee to support the Affordable Housing Trust, noting that meeting delays allowed misinformation to generate public opposition.

items.title: Tenant Displacement at Brooks Park Estates
items.summary: Leming reported receiving notice of displacements affecting 21 tenants at 208 Main Street, citing the situation as evidence of the need for trust funding to enable non-profit property acquisitions.

items.title: Council Demographics and Upcoming Housing Initiatives
items.summary: Leming discussed demographic shifts on the City Council, the contentious atmosphere at recent public meetings, and upcoming committee work on commercial linkage fees and zoning.
